Drafted by gate/tools/wave.py (F14-T11) and read by the curator before import (R13). -/

open Nat Filter Topology
open Erdos942

theorem Opn.erdos_942 :
    ∃ c > 0, ∃ (o : ℕ → ℝ), o =o[atTop] (1 : ℕ → ℝ) ∧
    (∀ᶠ n in atTop, erdos_942.h n < (Real.log n) ^ (c + o n)) ∧
    {n | erdos_942.h n > (Real.log n) ^ (c - o n)}.Infinite := by
  sorry
